Ally Calls

Everyone the party has helped since Willowbrook turns up at the muster below @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cde61798bfdf1c71]{Rosehold}. Most of them hold the line outside. A few can be called inside the castle: each ally answers once, then goes back to the fight below.

How many: each PC picks two allies at the muster to carry as calls (so four to six in all). Princess Amy and Aurelius come regardless and do not use up a pick. Calling an ally is free on your turn; they arrive at once, do their one thing, and leave. An ally who was never befriended in play is not available.

Ally Earned The call
Daisy of Silverspire Sessions 2, 5, 8, 10 Lullaby. One group of living enemies Nearby (up to 6) falls asleep without a SAVE. Works on Thornsworn, not on thorn or ice things.
Nim the Badger Freed in session 5; "call my name" Poof! The whole party and anyone they are carrying are whisked to any room of the castle they have already visited.
Billy Goat Crackers, session 6; freed from the orb, session 8 The run-up. Destroys one door, gate, barricade or portcullis outright, or hits one enemy for d10+d10. Demands crackers afterwards.
Mama Bear, Pebble and Pit Cub cured, session 8 One furious round. Bite d10 and Claws d6 against up to two enemies, and whoever she is defending takes no damage until her next turn.
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.be34807ba0cd994b]{Thistledown} and the pixies Pond saved, session 10 Pranks. For one whole fight, every hero has advantage on their first attack each round, and one enemy leader speaks in someone else's voice (its orders are ignored).
Nettie Blackthorn Tea and grave dust, sessions 6 and 8 Dissolve. She uncorks something black and bubbly: ends one Curse, Ailment or corruption effect on everyone present, and hands over one fresh Corruption Cure.
Grumbold the Troll Sneezes cured, session 9 A spare tooth. A wall of thorny stone, ten feet high, grows wherever a hero points and lasts the scene. Or he simply holds a doorway: nothing passes him for the scene.
Bannik Soap and a black hen, session 7 Under the wall. Before the assault, he tunnels the party into the Cistern (D1), skipping the gatehouse. During it, one burst of nostril spray: everyone hostile Nearby tests GRACE, d8 on a failure, d4 on a success.
Mari Lwyd Rheumatism cured, session 7 The Night Mare rides. Skeletal steeds for everyone: cross the causeway, the courtyard or the Stair of Vows in one move, ignoring hazards on the way.
Puca The circus, session 7 The catapult. Before the assault, launches the party over the wall onto the ramparts (B7). GRACE test each; a failure is d6 and a very public landing (+1 Cold). Filly has advantage: she has done this before.
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.87ad7c19cda317ad]{Pippin Cobbleton} Compass commission, session 11 The key that opens anything. One lock, binding, seal or pair of manacles opens, including a thorn-sealed door. Fifty silver, payable later.
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.b71f496a108e185d]{Sir Raphael}, @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.ef922601c8d5be97]{Lady Michelle}, @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.9f815b40de6fa230]{Sir Parker} Technically allied, session 11 Choose one: Michelle's song drops one magical ward or shatters every glass raven in earshot; Parker opens any ordinary lock or disarms any one trap; Raphael's ballad (now about the dragon he killed in session 12) gives everyone back one spent Gift Die.
The Boneyard crystal wolves Rations and fetch, session 11 The pack. For one fight, four @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.85efeedd0097fcc8]{crystal wolves} flank with @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.420ce96ef2fb0f2c]{Major Ursa}; he and they attack with advantage. The pups ride in on his back. (Tawny, whom they loved, died in session 12.)
Villum Filly's dinner bargain, session 7 A place at the table. Appears at any Picnic. That Picnic restores all Heart Dice after they are spent, and cures every Ailment. He takes his seat as owed.
Morgana Twinkleberry, Fairy Godmother Session 1 onward Bibbidi. One d20 anyone has just rolled becomes a 1. Once in the whole castle.
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.5b4d496cc81a50b5]{Sir Finnian} Fooled in session 12; convinced by Amy afterwards (session 13) A magnificent entrance. He and his surviving guards hold one room against all comers for the scene, announcing themselves at volume (+1 Cold, and worth it).

The muster outside is run by Daisy and the PPS. If the Cold reaches 6, the Barrier begins to regrow and the allies below are in trouble: see @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.fa6597afb86e582d]{rosehold runbook}.
